candidates.name: Custom agent personas with scoped tools and MCP servers
candidates.definition: User-defined agent personas that capture team workflows/conventions, each with its own system prompt, tool restrictions, and optional Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, attachable to a session.
candidates.relevance_suggestion: Distinct from the 3 features: an extensibility/configuration capability for shaping agent behavior rather than autonomous execution, background running, or orchestration itself.

evidence.excerpt: Custom agents are lightweight agent definitions you attach to a session, with each agent having its own system prompt, tool restrictions, and optional MCP servers.

candidates.name: Layered instruction precedence (personal/repository/organization)
candidates.definition: Ability to define custom instructions at multiple scopes with a documented precedence order applied automatically to prompts.

evidence.excerpt: Personal instructions take the highest priority. Repository instructions come next, and then organization instructions are prioritized last.

candidates.name: Agent firewall / network isolation
candidates.definition: The coding agent environment runs with a configurable firewall and restricted internet access to constrain outbound network calls during execution.
candidates.relevance_suggestion: Network egress control is a distinct security capability of the execution environment beyond compute isolation.

evidence.excerpt: You can customize Copilot's environment to preinstall tools or dependencies, set environment variables, upgrade from standard GitHub-hosted runners to larger runners, enable Git Large File Storage (LFS), and disable or customize the agent's firewall.
